committees.name: Education
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for helping in matters pertaining to the school and Islamic education.

committees.name: Finance and Investment
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for all fundraising activities on behalf of the center, and for supervising of the financial management of the assets and liabilities of the ICB.

committees.name: Membership and Bylaws
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for all routine administrative matters, and preparation and interpretation of the by laws. The Secretary shall be a statutory member of the committee.

committees.name: Religious Affairs
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for organization of lectures, seminars, and group discussions in the center.

committees.name: Library
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for looking after the library.

committees.name: Social Activities
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for all social activities in the center.

committees.name: Public Relations
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for public relations and liaison with other Islamic organizations. It is also responsible for all activities involving various outreach groups and media.

committees.name: Maintenance / Building
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for general upkeep and maintenance of the facilities in the ICB. It shall also be responsible for planning and supervising of any future expansions to the existing facilities of the center.

committees.name: Youth
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for organizing activities for the Junior members of the center.

committees.name: Cemetery
committees.description: This committee shall be responsible for all affairs relating to the Muslim section of the Forest Hills cemetery.

committees.name: Information Technology
committees.description: This committee maintains and manages the IT and network infrastructure for ICB Wayland, serving the diverse needs of the board, volunteers, students, teachers, parents, and visitors. Maintains ICB Wayland's website, and IT backend (servers, network, AV etc).

committees.name: Family Matters
committees.description: Family Matters Committee aims to support the development of strong, harmonious and connected Muslim families, and also supports individuals in building a strong communal network. Our programs center on helping people create greater socio-emotional wellbeing, and greater connection with others and with Allah swt. Our areas of focus include: Parenting Support, Family Dynamics & Communication, Healthy Relationships, Mental Health, Emotional Wellbeing, Brotherhood and Sisterhood, Elder Support

committees.name: Outreach
committees.description: This committee organizes and manages interfaith activities that promote an understanding of Islam and Muslims. We receive visitors from local houses of worship, host school and adult education groups, send speakers to events, represent ICB in local communities where a Muslim voice is needed, and arrange visits that welcome the wider community into the center.

committees.name: Family Promise Metrowest
committees.description: ICB is a support organization of Family Promise Metrowest (FPM) a cooperative, interfaith partnership offering hope to homeless families with children.

committees.name: ICB Cares
committees.description: This committee outreach and extends warm gestures to anyone in the community, during times of sickness or loss.

committees.name: Green
committees.description: This committee works on reducing our negative impact on the environment and moving towards becoming a zero-carbon congregation. Our multi-faceted approach includes waste reduction and improving the energy efficiency of our building.
